claims: The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission is being broadcast 24/7 on NASA's YouTube channel.
The Artemis II mission is being broadcast 24/7 on NASA+.
NASA's broadcast of the Artemis II mission shows live views from the Orion spacecraft as it travels to the Moon.
NASA provides dedicated feeds showing views from the Orion spacecraft as it orbits the Moon.
The AROW (Artemis Real-time Orbit Website) tracks the Orion capsule's position relative to Earth and the Moon.
The AROW includes an augmented reality feature on the mobile app.
The Artemis II mission is journeying around the Moon.
